reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread. I logged her tip as unverified hearsay, not as a confirmed contact.

**What I told her:** None of the sources she can access name Oriel Brevik or anyone as the main contact for the Linden rollout at Marrow Fieldworks. That means I can't confirm or rule out the tip. Marrow Fieldworks appears in a public note about Central team handoffs, so I suggested she ask the account owner on that team. I also said I won't pass the name on as fact until someone confirms it.

**What I checked:** Before checking anything, I confirmed she's a member of #north-team. Then I ran the knowledge-base search with her name and the key terms. It returned only her own message, already saved with her name and marked "unverified." I didn't use `search_messages` and didn't read channels she isn't in.

No finance figures, outside mail or approvals were involved.
